sim.title: Track simulation
sim.hint: Illustration based on arrival times and delays. Positions and track layout are simulated, not live measurements. Shows the next train on each reported platform within one hour.
sim.demoHint: DEMO · fictional trains, clock accelerated 30×. No real traffic is shown.
sim.stale: Data is over two minutes old: the illustration is frozen. Refresh to update.
sim.empty: No upcoming arrivals with a reported platform and time. Try the demo while the signal is red.
sim.unassigned: %1 trains without a platform: kept off the diagram.
sim.osm: Layout inferred from © OpenStreetMap contributors · ODbL. Undocumented tracks remain unverified.
sim.mapPrivacy: Queries OpenStreetMap via HTTPS on station selection (Overpass as fallback). Local cache: 7 days. No periodic map refresh.

sim.map.unavailable: Map source unavailable. Only previously verified data is shown.
